result.document_summary: Part 2 of 2 of M.G.L. c. 151B § 4 (Massachusetts unlawful discrimination practices), covering credit-age exceptions, employment discrimination, sexual harassment, and genetic-information provisions.
result.notes: This part of c. 151B § 4 contains no rules in the six in-scope categories (rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, algorithmic rent setting). The only housing-related text is paragraph 18 on sexual harassment of tenants, which is outside the scope categories; the rest concerns credit and employment discrimination.
